title.narrative: 15 Nov 2023 | Project Result / Case Study: https://www.adb.org/results/new-landfill-wastewater-treatment-plant-promote-clean-climate-resilient-urban-environment-pursat-cambodia
Grant 0454: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 07 Jul 2025
Loan 3311: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 07 Jul 2025
Loan 8295: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 07 Jul 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: As of 30 March 2025, the overall project progress was estimated at 98%. The current loan closing date is 30 April 2025 with no further extension.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42285/42285-013-apfs-en_6.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Sep 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42285/42285-013-iee-en_6.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Jun 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42285/42285-013-rp-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42285/42285-013-sddr-en_11.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Apr 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42285/42285-013-smr-en_16.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: The report on Climate Change Adaptation in Urban Development was presented in June 2018. Review and update was made in March 2025.
(i)Sub-Degree 103 of 29 June 2021 on wastewater treatment standard was issued. (ii) MPWT's Prakas 038 on 11 March 2023 on adoption of National Guideline on Fecal Sludge treatment standard using planted Drying Beds Technology. (iii) MPWT's Prakas 040 on adoption of Technical Specification for sewerage works. (iv) The sewerage law was promulgated on 22 November 2024.
Two WWTP with a total capacity of 7.3 MLD has
been constructed as explained below:
Pursat sewerage collection system and WWTP
(capacity = 2.1 MLD) works were completed on 19
June 2023. Construction of Kampong Chhnang
WWTP (capacity = 5.2 MLD) commenced on 1st
February 2023, and completed in February 2025.
O&M training for both WWTPs has been conducted
Total for the controlled landfill in both towns = 156,000 tons.
Kampong Chhnang landfill capacity: 72,000 tons
Pursat landfill capacity:84,000 tons
All works for the landfills have been completed.
Equipment to operate the landfills was delivered to
the local authorities in Kampong Chhnang and
Pursat on 14 & 15 December 2023 respectively.
Kampong Chhnang started operations on 17
February 2024.
Pursat landfill started operations on 17 April 2024.
O&M training for both landfills has been conducted.
A total of 1,447 latrines (740 for ID Poor & 707 for
vulnerable groups) were constructed. In Pursat 154
latrines for ID Poor (77 = 50% FHHs households)
only, no vulnerable groups.
In Kampong Chhnang, 1,293 latrines were
constructed, including 702 (54%) for female-headed
households. This total includes 586 ID Poor latrines
and 707 latrines for vulnerable groups identified by
the Provincial Authority in conjunction with the
village chiefs.
A combined total of 72.73 km of drains have been
rehabilitated and constructed.
In Pursat: 25.54 km of new drains were constructed;
27.19 km of existing drains were rehabilitated and
cleaned.
Total for Pursat = 52.73 km
Construction works were completed on 19 June
2023.
In Kampong Chhnang: 8.0 km of new drainage lines
were installed; 12.0 km of existing drainage lines
were cleaned and rehabilitated.
Total for Kampong Chhnang = 20.00 km
O&M trainings have been conducted for both towns.
The number of staff trained is shown below.
Sanitation:
- Pursat: 18 (8=44% female) participants,
- Kampong Chhnang: 22 (10=45% female)
participants
- Total 40 (18=45% females) participants,
Solid waste:
- Pursat: 61 (17=28% female) participants,
- Kampong Chhnang: 66 (15=23% female)
participants
- Total 127 (32=25% females) participants
Grand-total for all trainings:
- Sanitation: 40 (18=45% female) participants
- Solid Waste: 127 (32=25% female)
participants
Grand-Total: 167 (50=30% female) participants
Gender sensitive hygiene promotion campaign was
successfully conducted in both provinces. The total
number of participants attending the campaigndirect beneficiaries') included:
- Pursat: 192 (137=71% female) participants,
- Kampong Chhnang: 117 (74=63% female)
participants
- Total 309 (211=68% females) participants,
Prior to the promotion campaign 60 (39=65%
females) participants from both towns: KCG=30
(19=63%females) and PRS=30 (20=67%females)
attended the campaign trainings.
The USUs for the solid waste management for both
Kampong Chhnang and Pursat Provinces have been
established under the Provincial Authorities.
Sewerage and Wastewater Treatment Plant
Management units, under DPWT for each town, are
being established. MPWT is processing the relevant
documentation.
To ensure 20% of staff within the units are female,
a mandate requiring 20% female staff is recruited
has been included in the Operations and
Maintenance (O&M) manual.
